text.tspan: Share of countries that have had a woman as chief executive
Share of current countries that have had a woman as chief executive since 1789.
Note: "Chief executive" is defined here as the head of government (such as Germany's Angela Merkel) or the head of state (such as Argentina's
Cristina Fernández de Kirchner), whoever has more power over the appointment and dismissal of cabinet ministers. Democracies as identified
by V-Dem's "Regimes of the World" classification.
